description: This file defines the ApiGlobalErrorResponse class, which encapsulates structured HTTP error responses for the API. It includes various static factory methods to generate common error responses, such as authentication errors, validation errors, conflicts, and server errors, with detailed error information.

classes.name: ApiGlobalErrorResponse
classes.description: A class representing structured error responses for the API, including error messages, status codes, and a list of parameter errors. Contains static methods for generating common error responses.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an ApiGlobalErrorResponse with specified status code, message code, developer message, user message, and optional list of parameter errors.

methods.name: unAuthenticated
methods.description: Generates an error response indicating the user is unauthenticated.

methods.name: invalidTenantIdentifier
methods.description: Generates an error response indicating an invalid tenant identifier.

methods.name: invalidInstanceTypeMethod
methods.description: Generates an error response for invalid method calls on an instance type.

methods.name: loanIsLocked
methods.description: Returns an error indicating the specified loan is locked.

methods.name: conflict
methods.description: Returns a conflict error related to concurrent modifications.

methods.name: unAuthorized
methods.description: Returns an error indicating insufficient privileges.

methods.name: notFound
methods.description: Indicates a requested resource was not found.

methods.name: badClientRequest
methods.description: Indicates a bad request due to validation errors.

methods.name: serviceUnavailable
methods.description: Indicates the service is temporarily unavailable.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Retrieves the list of parameter errors.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the error response to a JSON string.
